newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse ends session higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse ends session higher.

text.p: The Casablanca stock market closed on Wednesday 0.13 percent higher in a market still illiquid, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 526.38 from 525.67 points on Tuesday.

Brasseries du Maroc shed eight dirhams to 2,035 dirhams. The firm announced last week it had purchased 80 percent of soft drinks firm Societe Industrielle Marocaine (SIM) for $52 million). It controls 95 percent of Morocco's beer market. It also manufactures under licence Coca Cola and Heineken brands.
ONA group and Societe Nationale d'investissement, the two biggest holdings, were up respectively five and eight dirhams to close at 650 and 605 dirhams.
In the banking sector, Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie rose 12 dirhams to 428 dirhams.
Leading stock Wafabank closed unchanged at 675 dirhams.
Credit firm Credor which was floated on the bourse in December last year, fell three dirhams to 620 dirhams.
"There is much speculation on this stock that's why it has a tendency to drop or increase significantly almost every day," a broker at Casablanca-based Credit du Maroc said.
Oil refinery Samir dipped nine dirhams to close at 278 after one-week steady gains.
"There were more offers than demands," he said
Traded volume on the official market was 65.2 million from 81.3 million the previous session.
